lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration posterior to the fifth gill slit, with approximately 4-5 visible vertical columns and 3-4 horizontal rows of primary nodes within the central flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal carinae to form anchor nodes where the largest high-luminance blobs are centered, particularly evident in the mid-flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with peak intensity on the dorsal edge of the ridge and a shadow-induced low-intensity trough immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits displays a labyrinthine/vermiculated pattern where high-luminance pixels form interconnected curvilinear paths rather than discrete circular centroids.
